instruction: in/manifest.txt lines are '<filename>|<YYYY-MM-DD>|<label>' (label may be empty). Produce a rename plan only (do not rename anything) in out/rename_plan.json: an array, in manifest order, of {"from": filename, "to": new name}. new name = '<date>_<label>_<NN>.<ext>' where label is lowercased with whitespace runs replaced by '-', the '_<label>' part is dropped when label is empty, NN is a 2-digit counter per distinct '<date>[_label]' stem starting at 01, and ext is lowercased.
note: All paths are relative to the workspace root.
